title: Software Developer
description:
About The Company

InNuce Solutions GmbH develops cloud-based software that helps businesses manage company vehicles and fleets more efficiently. Founded in 2004 and based in Hamburg-Ottensen, we combine deep industry knowledge with a passion for practical, modern technology. Our SaaS platform, Fleetscape IP, supports organizations across Europe in managing their fleets more effectively and sustainably. Backed by DKV Mobility, we are part of a broader effort to make business mobility smarter and help companies respond to changing operational and environmental needs.

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Developer Frontend (m/f/d) to help shape the user experience of Fleetscape IP. You will build and improve web-based interfaces that make complex fleet management tasks intuitive, responsive, and reliable. Working closely with backend developers, product management, and customer service, you will contribute throughout the development lifecycle—from discussing requirements and designing solutions to implementation, testing, and release.

This is a hands-on position for a developer who cares about clean architecture as well as the details of a polished user interface. You will take part in an agile team, bring ideas forward, and help develop a flexible frontend foundation that can scale with our product and customers. Your work will contribute directly to software used by companies across Europe.

Qualifications

A degree in computer science or a comparable qualification.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript, together with practical experience using React and Next.js.
Knowledge of GraphQL is an advantage.
A basic understanding of backend structures and, ideally, initial experience with container technologies.
Experience working in an agile software development environment and contributing to collaborative development practices.
A proactive, responsible, and goal-oriented approach, with the ability to take ownership of tasks and work through challenges.
Strong communication skills and an open, collaborative personality, with good German and English language skills.

Responsibilities

Develop new features and enhance the web-based interfaces of our Fleetscape IP fleet management software.
Contribute actively to agile sprints, including planning, implementation, review, and continuous improvement.
Help design and evolve a flexible, scalable frontend architecture that supports a performant and intuitive user experience.
Build web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and GraphQL, integrating with our technology environment, including Spring Boot, Hibernate, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Maintain and improve test environments, carry out software tests, and analyze results to support consistently high product quality.
Work closely with product management, backend development, and customer service to plan and deliver features and assist with product-related support.
Share ideas, communicate technical considerations, and help the team identify practical improvements to the product and its development processes.

Benefits

Competitive compensation based on your experience and qualifications.
Flexible working hours, flexitime, and the option to work from home.
30 days of annual leave, with Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve also provided as days off.
A contribution toward the Deutschlandticket, supported occupational pension provision, and access to JobRad.
Comprehensive opportunities for professional development and continuing education.
A family-friendly workplace with short decision-making paths and close collaboration.

Join our agile development team and help shape the future of business mobility. We welcome applications that include a résumé, relevant certificates, your potential start date, and salary expectations.

Equal Opportunity

InNuce Solutions GmbH welcomes applicants of all genders and backgrounds. We value respectful collaboration and believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our team and our products. All qualified candidates will be considered fairly, without discrimination. References to a particular gender in job-related wording are intended to include people of all genders.
